fields.text: UTF-8 provider input after canonical normalization
fields.language: explicit BCP-47 locale or language code
fields.model_constraints: registry identity, revision, license and capability constraints; never an arbitrary path
fields.consent_proof: VoiceConsentProof when a human voice reference or identity is used
fields.reference_transcript: text plus digest for transcript-dependent cloning
fields.experimental_language_ack: explicit acknowledgement; never creates production eligibility

rules: status MUST equal GRANTED at admission and execution time
scope MUST include VOICE_SYNTHESIS and VOICE_CLONING when applicable
purpose MUST cover the requested output use
subject_authorized MUST be true
provenance_ref and revocation_ref MUST be non-empty
expired or revoked consent MUST fail closed
provider MUST NOT mint, infer, extend or persist consent
audio_sha256 MUST match bytes consumed by provider
transcript digest MUST match bytes/text consumed when a transcript is used
voice identity MUST remain stable across request, decision, result and evidence
reference retention and deletion MUST follow the authorized policy
no silent provider, model, device, cloud or language fallback
hu-HU cloning MUST select an admitted Hungarian cloning provider
unsupported or unverified language routes MUST fail closed
research-only or non-commercial providers MUST NOT serve production requests
open-source code classification MUST NOT be inherited by model or voice artifacts
unknown, incompatible or purpose-restricted rights MUST fail closed
license acceptance MUST be explicit and auditable when required
result MUST bind request, provider, runtime, model, reference, decision, device and output lineage
native-rate master MUST be preserved when media projection resamples
result MUST carry language promotion eligibility and synthetic-audio disclosure
result MUST NOT promote provider-specific session semantics into canonical authority
